payload.text: `lib/templates/.claude/settings.json` carries `permissions.deny` rules `Edit(/AGENTS.md)` and `Edit(/.claude/AGENTS.md)`, no `Write(...)` rule (Claude Code consults `Edit(path)` and `Read(path)` rules only and warns at startup about a `Write(path)` rule; `Edit` rules govern every built-in tool that writes a file) and none against `CLAUDE.md`; the leading `/` anchors each at the project the settings file belongs to, not the current directory; and the file stays byte-identical on every machine.
